title: Sync from live: a row the live site deleted and inserted again under a new number with the same unique key (Joomla's installer rewriting a component's administrator menu items on an extension update) replaces the copy's untouched row instead of being listed as Tracy's version kept; a copy row Tracy changed, or one the live site did not delete, is still a conflict
expect: S1: every test passes, among them the three #1699 tests: the replaced administrator menu items (101, 102 → 2358, 2359) come over with no kept and no conflict, 101/102 gone, the child pointing at 2358 and Tracy's own menu edit kept; when the copy changed 101 both 101 (delete-modify) and 2358 (unique-key) are kept; a live row clashing with a copy row the live site did not delete stays a unique-key conflict

selectors.host: live_sync.py DbMerge.merge_rows unique-key clash (k.cls = 'U', LEFT JOIN kd on rows the live site deleted)

fence: A sync never reports as a conflict a change only one side made
